title: REPORT on competition policy – annual report 2024
part_text: 5. Underlines the need for coordinated, targeted and truly European industrial policy to boost industrial upgrading, to reduce the technology gap with China and the US, to preserve employment levels and to foster the green transition; notes that this must not result in market dominance or abuse thereof, price distortion or economic inefficiencies, and points to the need for effective merger control procedures;
